segments.name: Australia
products: village rooms and hospitality services for owned rooms
food service and other services, including facilities management
segments.description: Operates owned villages and customer-owned facilities in Australia, providing accommodation, hospitality, food service and facility management to mining and energy workforces.
segments.evidence: Our Australian segment reported revenues in 2025 that were $33.3 million, or 8%, higher than in 2024.

segments.name: Canada
products: lodge rooms and hospitality services for owned rooms
Mobile facility rental and associated services
food service, laundry and water and wastewater treatment services
segments.description: Operates owned lodges, mobile assets and customer-owned facilities in Canada, providing accommodation, food service, laundry and maintenance to oil sands and pipeline workforces.
segments.evidence: Our Canadian segment reported revenues in 2025 that were $66.5 million, or 27%, lower than 2024.

revenueModel.text: Mining, oil, construction and engineering customers pay for lodging, catering, housekeeping, maintenance and facility management at owned villages or at customer-owned accommodation.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide hospitality services to remote workforces in Australia and Canada, including catering and food service, lodging, housekeeping and maintenance at accommodation facilities that we or our customers own.

changes.text: In 2024 Civeo sold the McClelland Lake Lodge in Canada, reducing its Canadian lodge footprint.
changes.evidence: We recorded $5.7 million in net gains associated with the sale of the McClelland Lake Lodge in 2024.
